selected_passages.title: sources/Is_Sam_Bankman-Fried_a_bad_man_or_a_good_boy_Lawyers_swap_opening_statements_before_first_witnesses_take_the_stand
selected_passages.text: The second day of the Sam Bankman-Fried trial featured starkly contrasting opening statements where prosecutors painted him as a liar who stole billions for a lavish lifestyle, while his defense argued he was a good-faith startup founder who acted innovatively. The day concluded with the testimony of victim Marc-Antoine Julliard and former friend Adam Yedidia, who revealed his concerns about unwittingly contributing to the alleged crimes through code he wrote.

The day concluded with the testimony of victim Marc-Antoine Julliard and former friend Adam Yedidia, who revealed his concerns about unwittingly contributing to the alleged crimes through code he wrote.

selected_passages.text: Sam Bankman-Fried's criminal trial for seven counts of fraud and conspiracy against FTX has begun, following the exchange's collapse in November 2022 due to severe liquidity issues and mismanagement of customer funds. The once-valued $32 billion crypto empire filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy, leading to the arrest of Bankman-Fried and the guilty pleas of former executives Gary Wang and Caroline Ellison, while the trial proceeds with high-profile legal representation.

Sam Bankman-Fried's criminal trial for seven counts of fraud and conspiracy against FTX has begun, following the exchange's collapse in November 2022 due to severe liquidity issues and mismanagement of customer funds.
